Business: Vardhman Polytex Limited manufactures and sells yarns and garments in India. It operates through Textiles and Real Estate segments. The company offers carded, combed, organic, and BCI cotton yarns; cotton polyester yarns; and grey and dyed value-added yarns. Vardhman Polytex Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Ludhiana, India.
